sample_unit: responses (20 questions in triplicate per chatbot)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Flesch Reading Ease Score) on liver cancer questions
links.effect: ChatGPT mean FRES 29 (college graduate), Gemini 30 (college), Bing 40 (college); differences significant (p < 0.001)
links.quote: ChatGPT responses were the least readable (mean Flesch Reading Ease Score 29; college graduate), followed by Gemini (30; college) and Bing (40; college; p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Accuracy and reliability of chatbot answers to hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis and management questions
links.effect: Accurate: ChatGPT 9/20 (45%), Gemini 12/20 (60%), Bing 6/20 (30%); accurate and reliable: 6 (30%), 8 (40%), 3 (15%); no significant accuracy differences
links.quote: Of the twenty questions, ChatGPT answered nine (45%), Gemini answered 12 (60%), and Bing answered six (30%) questions accurately; however, only six (30%), eight (40%), and three (15%), respectively, were both accurate and reliable.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, Gemini, Bing) answering questions on liver cancer diagnosis and management evaluated by expert physicians for accuracy, reliability, and readability, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
